name: World of Warcraft: Forever
summary: World of Warcraft: Forever is set in the year after the Third War: Thrall's Horde has settled Durotar, Stormwind is ruled by a regent for its boy-king and the Forsaken hold the Undercity. Its world includes the Skyborne of Zephras Isle, the contested Riverglades and Shen'dralas, sacred Mount Hyjal and the city of Dalaran rising from its ruins in the Alterac Mountains.

sections.title: The World After the Third War
sections.body: The Burning Legion has been driven back at Mount Hyjal, but the world it left behind is raw. Thrall's Horde of orcs, trolls and tauren has made its home in Durotar and Mulgore, and the Forsaken under Sylvanas Windrunner have joined it from the ruins of Lordaeron. In Stormwind, Highlord Bolvar Fordragon rules as regent for the boy-king Anduin Wrynn while King Varian is missing. The dwarves of Ironforge, the exiled gnomes and the night elves of Teldrassil stand with the Alliance, and the Scourge still holds the Plaguelands.

sections.title: The Skyborne
sections.body: The Skyborne, or shen'dorei, descend from night elves who rebelled against Prince Tortheldrin of Eldre'Thalas and escaped when wind spirits carried their island, Zephras Isle, into Skywall, the Elemental Plane of Air. Ages there turned them into high elves, and a growing number are born blue-skinned. The spirits vanished centuries ago, Zephras Isle is slowly breaking apart, and the Skyborne look back toward Azeroth: their airships reach the Alterac Mountains near Dalaran and Mulgore's Skywatcher Plateau. Skyborne fight for both the Alliance and the Horde.

sections.title: Lands to Explore
sections.body: Zephras Isle floats in Skywall as the Skyborne's homeland. The Riverglades, east of the Burning Steppes, is an old Stormwind frontier lost in the First War, where loyalists at Farholde Keep hold out against the wilds, Horde outposts and the Twilight's Hammer at Sunnyglade. Shen'dralas is a rugged borderland between Desolace, Feralas and Mulgore, contested by centaur, quilboar and outcasts. Mount Hyjal, the night elves' sacred mountain, still bears the scars of Archimonde's defeat. In the Alterac Mountains, the Kirin Tor have lowered Dalaran's shield and are rebuilding their city, and off Kalimdor's coast the Horde and the Alliance battle over the Darkspear Islands.

sections.title: Dungeons and Raids
sections.body: Danger waits beneath the cities and in the far corners of the world: the Hall of Thanes deep under Ironforge, the haunted Ruins of Lordaeron above the Undercity, an excavation site in the Wetlands, the City of Dalaran itself, the Drowned City in Stranglethorn Vale, Krol'dok Stronghold in the Riverglades, Alcaz Prison in Dustwallow Marsh, Blackmaw Hold in Azshara and the Shaper's Terrace in Un'Goro Crater. On Mount Hyjal, the Barrow Deeps and Hyjal Summit test the mightiest war bands.

sections.title: Who Walks Which Path
sections.body: Warriors come from every race. Paladins are humans, dwarves or Forsaken. Shaman are orcs, tauren, trolls, dwarves or Horde Skyborne. Priests are humans, dwarves, gnomes, night elves, trolls or Forsaken. Mages are humans, gnomes, orcs, trolls, Forsaken or Alliance Skyborne. Warlocks are humans, gnomes, orcs, trolls or Forsaken. Hunters are humans, dwarves, night elves, orcs, tauren, trolls or Skyborne. Rogues come from every race but the tauren, and druids are night elves, tauren or Skyborne.

faq.q: When is World of Warcraft: Forever set?
faq.answer: In the year after the Third War, once the Forsaken have claimed the Undercity. Thrall leads the Horde from Orgrimmar, Highlord Bolvar Fordragon is regent of Stormwind for the boy-king Anduin, and the Scourge still holds the Plaguelands.

faq.q: What lands can I explore in WoW Forever?
faq.answer: Among its lands are Zephras Isle, the Skyborne's floating home in Skywall; the Riverglades, an old Stormwind frontier; Shen'dralas, a borderland between Desolace, Feralas and Mulgore; Mount Hyjal, the night elves' sacred mountain; and Dalaran, rising again in the Alterac Mountains. The Horde and the Alliance also fight over the Darkspear Islands.

High elves descended from night elves who fled Eldre'Thalas ages ago and lived on Zephras Isle in Skywall, the Elemental Plane of Air. With their island crumbling, they look back toward Azeroth, and they fight for both the Alliance and the Horde.

On the shore of Lordamere Lake in the Alterac Mountains. Archimonde shattered it in the Third War; the Kirin Tor have since lowered the shield they raised over the ruins, and the city is being rebuilt.

faq.q: What dungeons and raids are there?
faq.answer: Among them are the Hall of Thanes under Ironforge, the Ruins of Lordaeron above the Undercity, an excavation site in the Wetlands, the City of Dalaran, the Drowned City in Stranglethorn Vale, Krol'dok Stronghold in the Riverglades, Alcaz Prison in Dustwallow Marsh, Blackmaw Hold in Azshara and the Shaper's Terrace in Un'Goro Crater. The raids are the Barrow Deeps and Hyjal Summit on Mount Hyjal.

faq.q: Which classes can each race be?
faq.answer: Humans: warrior, paladin, hunter, rogue, priest, mage or warlock. Dwarves: warrior, paladin, hunter, rogue, priest or shaman. Night elves: warrior, hunter, rogue, priest or druid. Gnomes: warrior, rogue, priest, mage or warlock. Orcs: warrior, hunter, rogue, shaman, mage or warlock. Forsaken: warrior, paladin, rogue, priest, mage or warlock. Tauren: warrior, hunter, shaman or druid. Trolls: warrior, hunter, rogue, priest, shaman, mage or warlock. Skyborne: warrior, hunter, rogue or druid, plus mage in the Alliance and shaman in the Horde.

angles.text: Your people have only begun to return to Azeroth, and both the Alliance and the Horde have taken Skyborne into their ranks.
Some Forsaken still wield the Holy Light as paladins, though it burns them; Tyr's Watch holds Bandarion Keep in western Tirisfal.
Dwarves of Ironforge walk the shaman's path as well as the Light's, calling on stone and storm.
